title: AU host slot negotiates the caller's channel width instead of the descriptor default

needles: void set_preferred_channel_layout(int inputs, int outputs) override
AU host negotiates the caller's requested channel width

installed_sdk.rationale: set_preferred_channel_layout is a public virtual on the installed PluginSlot header, appended after every existing virtual (immediately after bypass_surface) so a downstream subclass keeps its slot layout -- the additive-only vtable ordering the pre-push guard enforces. Its body is a no-op, so a slot that does not override it behaves exactly as before and an SDK consumer that never calls it sees no change. Only the AU slot overrides it, because only a format that fixes its stream shape at initialize time needs the caller's width in advance.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline Timeline command is added or altered. `pulp audio render` is an audio-render command, not a Timeline surface, and its flags are unchanged -- --in-channels/--out-channels keep their documented meaning and now actually reach the AU slot.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation is added, removed or changed.

live_product_control.rationale: No product control, grant or policy projection is created. The change corrects the stream format an AU is initialized with inside the host slot; no musician-facing control surface is added.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time authoring capability is added or altered. The new virtual is a host-embedding detail, not an authoring operation.
